note: Trigger checks. Generic prompts in Korean and English.

evals.prompt: Merge these HTML reports into one page per part, but don't lose any information from the originals.

evals.prompt: Make a learning pack about how heat pumps work, as HTML with lots of diagrams and less text.
evals.expected_output: new_pack --pack → chapters with one section per term → check → build → open the one-page edition
